name: Banh hoi
summary: Bánh hỏi is the fine rice vermicelli Vietnam Tourism’s place page ties to Phong Điền. The four-day piece serves it under nem nướng Cái Răng, with sautéed garlic.
origin: Phong Điền on the place page, and with the Cái Răng pork at lunch.
where: Phong Điền, and at the lunch that follows the market.
seoDescription: Fine rice vermicelli from Phong Điền on Vietnam Tourism’s Can Tho page, served with nem nướng Cái Răng.
